pandoc 
  to: html
  output-file: index.html
  standalone: true
  title-prefix: Juan TORRES MUNGUÍA | HUMANITARIAN DATA SCIENTIST
  section-divs: true
  html-math-method: mathjax
  wrap: none
  default-image-extension: png
  css:
    - ../css/styles.css
    - blog.css
  toc: false
  
metadata
  document-css: false
  link-citations: true
  date-format: long
  lang: en
  editor: source
  theme: flatly
  mainfont: Signika
  fontawesome: true
  page-layout: article
  title: Blog
  subtitle: ''
  listing:
    contents: posts
    sort: date desc
    type: grid
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: true
    fields:
      - title
      - subtitle
      - categories
      - date
